messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 executive slate: contingency runway & deferred-offer sign-off

Folks —

Attached is the working Q3 executive slate (Q3-exec-slate-v3.xlsx). Short summary and asks below; please review and reply with your sign-off or escalations by EOD Tuesday (4/20). If we don’t have explicit direction I will move forward with the conservations in the green band (VP Sales & Head of Trust) and hold Head of Product as a contingency.

High-level items: 
- Roles requested: Head of Product (exec-banded), VP Sales (exec-banded), Head of Trust (security & compliance lead).
- Comp bands: listed in tab “Bands” — top-of-band for Head of Product is $420–480k OTE; VP Sales $350–420k OTE; Head of Trust $320–380k OTE.
- Budget impact (runway): Approving all three on-target increases OPEX run-rate by ~$1.4M annualized; deferring HoP reduces runway risk by ~0.9M.
- Contingency / fallback options: 30-day deferred offers for Head of Product (hold offer and candidate in warm pool), calibrated sign-on reductions, or convert one senior IC req into an interim director for Q3.

Asks: 
1) Marcus — sign-off or change for VP Sales compensation structure (can we push variable % up to 30% from 25%?)
2) Vivek — please confirm whether HoP is critical to start in Q3 or if we should move to deferred-offer status.
3) Finance/HR (Laura/Marissa) — confirm payroll timing constraints and provide DocuSign template for deferred offer language.

Attachments: Q3-exec-slate-v3.xlsx (tabs: Summary, Bands, Budget-impact, Candidate-pulse), deferred-offer-template.docx (draft language for holding offers).

If anyone wants a short sync, I’m available 11–12 today.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 executive slate: contingency runway & deferred-offer sign-off

Irene —

Thanks for the crisp pack. Quick thoughts: I’m supportive of VP Sales moving forward but prefer tightening the guaranteed comp and leaning more into variable (make target base ~10–12% lower than listed, and increase accelerators). That helps align to quota attainment and reduce fixed-cost risk.

I’m neutral on Head of Product starting in Q3. If the candidate is a clear strategic differentiator (proven seed-to-scale product leader with platform experience), we should fast-track. Otherwise, defer 30 days and revisit.

Approve Head of Trust to hire immediately — we’ve had recurring asks from customers and security is a gating item for at least two large deals.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the pack, Irene. Short decisions from my side: 

- Approve VP Sales with Marcus’s suggested comp structure modification. Please prepare a variable-first offer (higher upside, lower guaranteed).
- Approve Head of Trust to start immediately — security is non-negotiable for our enterprise targets this quarter. 
- Head of Product: do not finalize an active offer unless the candidate brings proprietary IP or has a verified track record shipping platform-scale ML products. If that’s the case, OK to proceed; otherwise place a deferred-offer for 30–45 days while we validate a tighter set of success metrics.

Operational ask: Marissa — if we go the deferred route for HoP, update the deferred-offer-template.docx to include explicit probation milestones at 30/90 days and the ability to convert sign-on to a retention bonus. Also confirm whether our equity band midpoints need to be adjusted for deferred starts.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the guidance — summarizing approvals and action items so we have a single source of truth: 

Approvals granted (per thread):
- VP Sales: APPROVED with revised comp structure (lower base, higher variable). I'll draft the offer and send the compensation summary to Marcus for final review before sending to candidate.
- Head of Trust: APPROVED to extend offer this week; recruiting to move to background checks and onboarding scheduling.
- Head of Product: CONDITIONAL — place deferred-offer (30–45 days) unless recruiting confirms the candidate meets the ‘strategic differentiator’ criteria. If candidate meets criteria, we will proceed to extend an active offer and align payroll timing.

Action items:
1) Marissa: Prepare DocuSign packages for VP Sales and Head of Trust using the attached deferred-offer-template.docx only for the HoP if deferred; otherwise use standard executive offer pack. Target docusign send by 4/19 EOD for the two approved roles.
2) Laura/Finance: confirm hire dates and run the updated OPEX impact into the Q3 forecast (Irene, please flag any shifts to the budget tab).
3) Marcus: approve final compensation summary (I will send a write-up by noon tomorrow).
4) Vivek: if you want the HoP reviewed for exception, tell recruiting to provide a one-pager with signals and two references; we will aim for a decision within 72 hours of receipt.

Attachments included in my send: Q3-exec-slate-v3.xlsx, deferred-offer-template.docx
DocuSign link (VP Sales & Head of Trust packet): https://docusign.com/redsuite/exec-offer-packages/12345
Sheets reference: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Q3ExecSlateV3 (updated tab: "Approved-Log").

I'll update the HR tracker after docusign completes. If anything changes please reply-all.

Best,
